name: Fuyuno Reiko
source: Reiko is a teacher at Haruki's middle school. She is a refined and hot blooded woman who is considered to be the ideal female teacher. In her youth she was known as a promising ballet dancer and she is also the adviser for the school ballet club. She has been married for three years and are friends with Sayoko.
